dgp: Z=sin(i/17); T=.6*Z+.8*cos(1.13*i)+.4*e; Y=1+2*T+.8*Z+.3*e; i=0..599; e=sum of 12 uniforms minus 6 from one 64-bit LCG stream (state 20240611; T's noise over all rows, then Y's)

oracle.method: linear law in `dgp`: the interventional mean at level x is intercept + treatment_coefficient * x + confounder_coefficient * mean(Z), the back-door average of the structural mean over the observed confounder; the confounded (unadjusted) slope is larger than the coefficient 2, so the adjusted curve is separated from the unadjusted one
asserted_outputs: the curve at each grid point (intercept + 2 x + 0.8 mean(Z)) within curve_absolute_tolerance
the planted off-support grid point lies beyond the largest treatment value
context_only_outputs: fixture_id and dgp text (checked only as a guard on the model used)
oracle.independence_basis: The generator regenerates the stated rows from the integer noise recurrence and solves the exact rational normal equations of Y on 1, T, Z; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated law and the noise recurrence.
oracle.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the stated law and declared inputs; no product implementation source was consulted and no earlier pinned numbers are reused.
